opening.argument: The earnings promise is paired with concrete instructions to fund and connect the trading bot. The description tells viewers to “Register and fuel your bot with $90” while claiming they can make “$2000 per Week with our trading strategy.” The walkthrough then directs them to grant read-and-write access, copy the API secret into UTrading, and complete the connection. The presenter confirms the account is fully connected and ready to trade. That makes the solicitation actionable, while the video provides no basis establishing that the promised returns occur.
